title: Vikshep Determinism Certificate
description: A Determinism Certificate bundles a Vikshep provenance manifest with conformance evidence (suite version, numerics version, backend, local self-test result) and an optional Ed25519 detached signature block. The signature proves WHICH installation produced the certificate; correctness is independently verifiable by any party with the open CPU reference by re-running the computation and comparing output OIDs. Certificates are RFC 8785 canonical JSON.

manifest.description: The full provenance manifest of the attested computation, following spec/provenance.schema.json. Embedded verbatim so that a verifier can re-run the computation without access to any Vikshep server.

conformance.description: Evidence that the issuing installation passed the VDS-1 conformance self-test at the time of issuance.

suite_version.description: Conformance suite version that was run (3 for suite v3, the current version).

numerics_version.description: Numerics version of the issuing binary; must equal manifest.numerics_version.

backend.description: Backend name that ran the self-test, for example 'cpu' or 'cuda'.

selftest_result.description: Outcome of the local conformance self-test.

signature.description: Optional Ed25519 detached signature. Proves which installation issued the certificate. Correctness of the computation is proven separately by re-running with the open CPU reference, so the signature is NOT required to verify a result.

key_id.description: Opaque identifier of the signing key, for example the lowercase hex of the 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

value.description: Base64url-encoded 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the SHA3-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical bytes of this certificate without the 'signature' member.
